column1: # Hand-maintained engine status rows, delimiter "@@" (not tab, so regexes stay readable).
# category @@ key @@ name @@ status @@ evidence @@ probe @@ note
# status: exact (law proved on binary/oracle) | mapped (implemented, law not independently proved)
#         approx (implemented with a labelled approximation) | reported (translator reports unsupported) | absent
# probe: "file::regex" must match in the named source file (searched under crates/ and vendor/);
#        "!file::regex" must NOT match. A failing probe marks the row "stale" on the dashboard.
# Evidence paths starting with specs/ live in ~/.cache/kontakto-wave2/specs/.
